'''Repulsorbridges''' were load-bearing structures incorporating [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology. They took several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] to build by a team of sentients or [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
